title: Amenability of Thompson Group and Interval Homeomorphism Groups
exact_target: Is Thompson's group $F$ amenable? Is the group $\mathrm{PL}_+(I)$ of orientation-preserving piecewise-linear homeomorphisms of the interval amenable?
